title: Asymmetric Thickness Reinitialization from Round-7 Optimum with 0.5x Step Size
scientific_hypothesis: Breaking thickness symmetry via odd/even layer offset initialization (+8nm/-8nm) will enable the gradient optimizer to escape the local minimum that trapped round-7 (score 0.5454), allowing finer phase adjustments across the 420-700 nm passband while maintaining dual stopband suppression at 355-365 nm and 1030-1080 nm.
design_principle: Asymmetric perturbation of optimized thickness values breaks the symmetry that may cause gradient-based optimizers to converge to saddle points or shallow local minima. Halved step size prevents overshoot into forbidden spectral regions during fine-tuning.
proposed_topology: exactly 6 alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers)
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack optimization principles allow non-quarter-wave thickness variation for broadened suppression bands
Gradient-based optimization with reduced step size enables fine phase control without spectral overshoot
expected_advantages: Escapes symmetric local minima from round-7
known_risks: Asymmetric initialization may converge to different but equally suboptimal local minimum
Halved step size may require more iterations to converge
execution_request_english: Optimize a 36-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 dielectric filter on fused silica substrate with air incidence at 0 degrees, unpolarized light. Initialize thicknesses from round-7 best candidate [32.0, 252.0, 24.0, 218.0, 31.0, 259.0, 33.0, 253.0, 26.0, 247.0, 24.0, 266.0, 23.0, 269.0, 22.0, 256.0, 23.0, 248.0, 25.0, 262.0, 24.0, 252.0, 21.0, 233.0, 21.0, 244.0, 30.0, 269.0, 31.0, 236.0, 22.0, 235.0, 23.0, 235.0, 29.0, 29.0] nm, then apply asymmetric offset: add +8 nm to odd-indexed layers (indices 0,2,4,...,34) and subtract 8 nm from even-indexed layers (indices 1,3,5,...,35). Clamp all thicknesses to 20-350 nm bounds. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with step size multiplier 0.5x. Optimize for: maximize transmittance in 420-700 nm band, minimize transmittance in 354-356 nm band, minimize transmittance in 355-365 nm band, minimize transmittance in 1030-1080 nm band. Wavelength grid: 300-1200 nm with 1 nm resolution. Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 6 alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 355-355 nm, 355-365 nm, 420-700 nm, 1030-1080 nm. soft objectives: high average transmittance in 420-700 nm; low average transmittance at 355 nm; low average transmittance in 355-365 nm; low average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high transmittance at 355 nm; high transmittance in 355-365 nm; high transmittance in 1030-1080 nm; high loss in 420-700 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 36 layers; layer thickness range 20-350 nm.
revision_reason: Following feedback directive to reinitialize with asymmetric thickness offsets (+8nm odd, -8nm even) from round-7 best candidate and halve optimizer step size to 0.5x to escape local minimum and enable fine-grained phase adjustment.
